scientific_integrity: Exact-parameter analytic proof supplied, separately corroborated by finite exact-rational checks; no independent validation or claim of priority proof.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional quadratic Gaussian target, Itô Euler step, fixed step, independent Gaussian noise and exact arithmetic.
Classifies finite-second-moment stability, not almost-sure Lyapunov exponents or arbitrary nonlinear Langevin targets.
Older matrix stochastic-stability literature may encode related general criteria; full text of DOI:10.1137/090771843 not read.
title: Sharp Euler mean-square stability and covariance bias for reversible-noise Gaussian Langevin sampling
